Description: One sync round (SyncService.RunAsync): the library on this device (Local), what is stored (Remote as a document, or RemoteText when it is not one), the passphrase, and the time. Expected says what the round reports, and the merged document it would apply or write. A round that fails writes nothing.

Input.Name: 01-first-sync
Input.Description: Nothing stored yet: this device writes its library.

Input.Name: 02-nothing-new
Input.Description: The file already says the same and this device checked in recently: nothing changes and nothing is written.

Input.Name: 03-heartbeat
Input.Description: Nothing changed, but this device last checked in more than 2 hours ago, so it writes to refresh that.

Input.Name: 04-heartbeat-boundary
Input.Description: Exactly 2 hours is not 'more than 2 hours': nothing is written.

Input.Name: 05-file-has-more
Input.Description: The file has an app this device lacks: the library should be updated (Changed), and nothing needs writing.

Input.Name: 06-this-device-has-more
Input.Description: This device has an app the file lacks: it is written.

Input.Name: 07-both-have-more
Input.Description: Each side has something new: the library should be updated and the file written.

Input.Name: 08-this-device-not-listed
Input.Description: The file does not list this device yet: it is written so the device shows up.

Input.Name: 09-turn-on-passphrase
Input.Description: A passphrase is set but the file is not locked: it is written locked.

Input.Name: 10-turn-off-passphrase
Input.Description: The file is locked but no passphrase is set on this device: the sync stops.

Expected.Message: This sync file is locked. Enter the passphrase you set up on your other device.

Input.Name: 11-locked-and-opened
Input.Description: The file is locked and the passphrase opens it. Nothing else changed, so it is not rewritten.

Input.Name: 12-wrong-passphrase
Input.Description: The passphrase does not open the file: the sync stops and nothing is written.

Expected.Message: That passphrase doesn't open the sync file.

Input.Name: 13-newer-format
Input.Description: The file was made by a newer version of ReleaseSync (Version 4; this one reads up to 3): the sync stops.

Expected.Message: The sync file was made by a newer version of ReleaseSync. Update ReleaseSync and try again.

Input.Name: 14-unreadable-file
Input.Description: The file is not valid JSON: the sync stops and nothing is written.

Expected.Message: The sync file isn't readable, so nothing was changed.

Input.Name: 15-blank-file
Input.Description: A blank file counts as nothing stored.

Input.Name: 16-older-format-read
Input.Description: A file written as Version 2 (before devices listed what they have installed) is still read. The result is Version 3, and the device is listed with the new fields, so it is written.

Input.Name: 17-publishes-inventory
Input.Description: This device says it is online and lists what it has installed; the file does not say so yet, so it is written.

Input.Name: 18-inventory-unchanged
Input.Description: The file already has the same online flag and list (in any order) and this device checked in recently: nothing is written. The order of the list does not matter.

Input.Name: 19-inventory-changed
Input.Description: One program on this device has a newer version than the file says: the change is written.

Input.Name: 20-goes-offline
Input.Description: This device is closing and says so: Online becomes false, which is written even though it checked in a minute ago.

Input.Name: 21-other-device-details-kept
Input.Description: What the PC says about itself is kept as the file has it: its list and online flag come through the merge untouched.
